translations.idiomatic: Under the Qing it served as the provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 租界在閩江北岸，曰南臺，與府城對。

translations.idiomatic: and southwest to Huanggang in Guangdong.

translations.idiomatic: Telegraph lines ran from Fuzhou north to Hangzhou, southwest to Guangzhou, east to Mawei and Chuanshi Hill, and northeast to Sandu Bay.

sentences.zh: 海線由川石山東通臺灣淡水，由廈門東北通上海，西南通香港。

translations.literal: Submarine cables ran east from Chuanshi Hill to Tamsui in Taiwan; from Xiamen northeast to Shanghai and southwest to Hong Kong.
translations.idiomatic: Submarine cables ran east from Chuanshi Hill to Tamsui in Taiwan, and from Xiamen northeast to Shanghai and southwest to Hong Kong.

translations.idiomatic: The sea enters from Wenzhou in Zhejiang, sweeps southwest through Funing, skirts the prefecture's Luoyuan and Lianjiang, and at a point 190 li east of the county forms Wuhumen.

translations.literal: Outside lies the open ocean; inside, the mouth of the Min River.
translations.idiomatic: Beyond lies the open ocean; within lies the mouth of the Min River.

sentences.zh: 閩江，閩大川，上匯富屯、沙、建三溪，至侯官分二派入：北派承洪山江，東逕中洲為南臺江，至中岐為馬頭江，合大定江、演江，亦曰東峽江，至羅星塔；

translations.literal: The Min River, the great river of Fujian, above gathers the Futun, Sha, and Jian streams; at Houguan it divides into two branches entering: the north branch receives the Hongshan River, runs east past Zhongzhou as the Nantai River, at Zhongqi becomes the Matou River, joins the Dading and Yan rivers—also called the East Gorge River—and reaches Luoxing Pagoda;
translations.idiomatic: The Min River, Fujian's chief stream, gathers the Futun, Sha, and Jian creeks upstream; at Houguan it splits into two branches. The northern branch takes the Hongshan River, runs east past Zhongzhou as the Nantai River, becomes the Matou River at Zhongqi, joins the Dading and Yan rivers—also called the East Gorge River—and reaches Luoxing Pagoda;

sentences.zh: 南派澤苗江入，為陶江，逕螺洲，左合黃山水，又東南為陰崎江，又東為烏龍江，右合榕溪，又東，亦曰西峽江，又東來會。

translations.literal: the south branch takes the Zemiao River in as the Tao River, passes Luozhou, joins Huangshan water on the left, turns southeast as the Yinqi River, then east as the Wulong River, joins Rong Creek on the right, runs east—also called the West Gorge River—and meets the other branch from the east.
translations.idiomatic: The southern branch receives the Zemiao River as the Tao River, passes Luozhou, joins Huangshan water on the left, turns southeast as the Yinqi River and east as the Wulong River, joins Rong Creek on the right, flows east—also called the West Gorge River—and reunites with the northern branch.

sentences.zh: 又東過青洲，右納太平港水，逕員山，又北支津北抵亭頭鄉。

translations.literal: It runs east past Qingzhou, takes in Taiping Harbor water on the right, passes Yuanshan, and a northern branch channel reaches north to Tingtou Township.
translations.idiomatic: It flows east past Qingzhou, takes in Taiping Harbor on the right, passes Yuanshan, and sends a northern branch channel north to Tingtou Township.

sentences.zh: 又東為琅琦江，復歧為二，一西北出五虎門，一東南與長樂分岸，為廣石江。

translations.literal: It runs east as the Langqi River, divides again into two—one northwest out through Wuhumen, one southeast sharing the shore with Changle as the Guangshi River.
translations.idiomatic: Farther east it becomes the Langqi River and splits again: one branch northwest through Wuhumen, the other southeast along the Changle shore as the Guangshi River.

sentences.zh: 梅花江出白猴嶼，併入焉。

translations.literal: The Meihua River issues from Baihou Islet and joins it.
translations.idiomatic: The Meihua River, issuing from Baihou Islet, merges into it.

sentences.zh: 其下歷興化、泉、漳至粵，水程二千里，陸千二百里。

translations.literal: Below it passes through Xinghua, Quan, and Zhang to Guangdong: two thousand li by water, twelve hundred li by land.
translations.idiomatic: Downstream it runs through Xinghua, Quanzhou, and Zhangzhou to Guangdong—a water route of 2,000 li and a land route of 1,200 li.

translations.literal: The Min Maritime Customs had two main ports: one stationed at Nantai, with the coastal defense subprefect;
translations.idiomatic: The Min Maritime Customs maintained two main ports: one at Nantai, staffed jointly with the coastal defense subprefect;

translations.literal: one stationed at Min'an Town, with the vice general.
translations.idiomatic: and one at Min'an Town, staffed jointly with the vice general.

sentences.zh: 順治十五年築城，置戰船，南北岸砲臺。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Shunzhi a wall was built, war junks stationed, and batteries placed on both north and south banks.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 15 fortifications were built, war junks stationed, and batteries erected on both banks.

sentences.zh: 縣丞駐營前，雍正十二年徙三水部。

translations.literal: The assistant magistrate was stationed at Yingqian; in the twelfth year of Yongzheng he was moved to the Sanshui section.
translations.idiomatic: The assistant magistrate was first posted at Yingqian and in Yongzheng 12 transferred to the Sanshui section.

translations.idiomatic: On the west bank stand Xianqizhai and Jiaoshanzhai; west to Zhanggang it becomes the Zhang River.

translations.idiomatic: Xiaoyou Creek, Jinping Mountain water, and Tangling water in the northwest divide to flow into Datian, Yongchun, and Youxi.

sentences.zh: 縣前溪上承小尤溪，東南自德化入，合龍背嶺水為梓溪。

translations.literal: Xianqian Creek above receives Xiaoyou Creek, enters southeast from Dehua, joins Longbeiling water as Zixi.
translations.idiomatic: Xianqian Creek rises from Xiaoyou Creek, enters from Dehua in the southeast, and joins Longbeiling water as Zixi.

sentences.zh: 又西北，左合小坑水，折東北為湯泉溪，至城南，匯為塔兜潭。

translations.literal: It runs northwest, joins Xiaokeng water on the left, turns northeast as Tangquan Creek, reaches south of the city, and gathers as Tadou Pool.
translations.idiomatic: It runs northwest, takes Xiaokeng water on the left, turns northeast as Tangquan Creek, reaches south of the city, and gathers into Tadou Pool.

sentences.zh: 又東北逕京口，右合仙峰溪，左上華水，至漈頭，英果溪合渡頭溪自其西來會，又北入尤溪。

translations.literal: It runs northeast past Jingkou, joins Xianfeng Creek on the right and Shanghuashui on the left, reaches Jitou; Yingguo Creek joins Dutou Creek from the west to meet, and runs north into Youxi.
translations.idiomatic: It runs northeast past Jingkou, takes Xianfeng Creek on the right and Shanghuashui on the left, reaches Jitou where Yingguo Creek and Dutou Creek join from the west, and runs north into Youxi.

translations.literal: Shenkou Creek in the southwest enters Ningyang.
translations.idiomatic: Shenkou Creek in the southwest flows into Ningyang.

translations.literal: To its south Wuling Anshui enters Zhangping.
translations.idiomatic: South of it Wuling Anshui flows into Zhangping.
